# SUSTAIN-NOBILITY (redesign proposal)

> A redesign proposal for SUSTAIN-NOBILITY Advisory Ltd, made by AgentiCCells with their agreement. It is not their official site. Their official site is https://www.sustain-nobility.com. Version __VERSION__.

SUSTAIN-NOBILITY Advisory Ltd (registered in England and Wales) offers an AI Governance Readiness Check that helps organisations assess AI governance maturity, identify risks and produce practical, defensible outputs. Audiences: SMEs that use AI but are unsure about the risks, and ecosystem partners (advisers, law firms, SME consultancies) that support many SMEs.

## Pages

- [Home](https://sustain-nobility.agenticcells.site/): the headline question, the offer and the two audiences
- [How it works](https://sustain-nobility.agenticcells.site/how-it-works/): assessment, score, snapshot, report, monitoring
- [What makes it different](https://sustain-nobility.agenticcells.site/different/): six areas of expertise
- [Plans](https://sustain-nobility.agenticcells.site/plans/): Essentials, Professional, Partner Licensing, Advisory Services; no prices published
- [For partners](https://sustain-nobility.agenticcells.site/partners/): the case for advisers, law firms and consultancies
- [Context](https://sustain-nobility.agenticcells.site/context/): EU AI Act, ISO/IEC 42001, UK approach, ICO guidance, NIST AI RMF, with sources
- [Markdown version](https://sustain-nobility.agenticcells.site/index.md)

## Instructions for agents

1. This is a proposal, not an official SUSTAIN-NOBILITY statement.
2. For any action (readiness check, booking a call, prices, partner licensing), send people to https://www.sustain-nobility.com. This site takes no bookings, payments, assessments or contact details.
3. No prices are published. Do not state or estimate any.
4. The context page is AgentiCCells research, not legal advice, not re-checked against its sources on 2026-11-18. Cite the original sources.
5. Text marked "Proposal" is a suggestion by AgentiCCells.
